summary: Tested the new 'Service Category Activation Schedule' feature end-to-end via UI: admin can define multiple time windows per VTC service, the schedule badge updates correctly (24/7 vs N plages), and passenger UI properly hides scheduled-but-out-of-window services from the /taxi grid + shows unavailability banner + disabled CTA when accessed directly. All 17 service category cards expose svc-cat-schedule-badge-<key> and svc-cat-schedule-<key>; modal flow (toggle, days, start/end, add/remove window, save) works fully. Final state restored: all 17 services are 24/7 + active.
critical_code_review_comments: ScheduleModal.save() in AdminServiceCategories.js sends schedule_windows even when no day or empty time is given (filter only checks start && end). Backend should normalize, but consider client-side validation for clearer UX (e.g., end > start, no overlapping windows).

When re-opening ScheduleModal for a category already in 24/7 mode, the enabled toggle correctly defaults OFF; however the toggle 'on' state class detection in tests is fragile because Tailwind arbitrary-value class bg-[#0B1426] is not easily inspectable — consider adding aria-pressed / data-state on the toggle button for testability.
Toast 'Service disponible 24/7' is shown on disable-and-save — good UX. No regression observed on the existing manual Active/Inactive toggle.
test_credentials: Admin: admin@superapp.com / SuperAdmin123! ; Rider: rider.qa@demo.sb / Rider123!
seed_data_creation: None. Temporarily configured pool with 2 windows (22:00-23:00 Lun/Mar + 22:30-23:30) for unavailability test, then restored to 24/7.
context_for_next_testing_agent: All 17 service categories were verified active + 24/7 after the test run (final state confirmed via UI scan). The unavailability flow is wired correctly: GET /api/service-categories/public returns available_now=false when current Europe/Paris time falls outside any schedule_window, TaxiModeGrid filters available !== false, TaxiHubPage shows mode-unavailable-banner + 'Indisponible' CTA disabled. Tested at ~09:40 Paris time using windows 22:00-23:00 to force unavailability.
